stock.description: UMP Healthcare Holdings Limited, an investment firm, delivers a broad spectrum of medical and wellness provisions across Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China. The company's operations are divided into two main divisions: Corporate Healthcare Solution Services and Clinical Healthcare Services. Its extensive service portfolio encompasses virtual medical support, general family practice, and specialized consultations covering diverse fields like internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, cardiology, dermatology, ENT, orthopedics, ophthalmology, urology, gastroenterology, endocrinology, and diabetes. Additionally, it provides comprehensive dental services, including implants, cosmetic procedures, periodontal care, and orthodontics, alongside traditional Chinese medicine. The company further extends its offerings to include physiotherapy, addressing muscle strengthening, limb and hand function, and eye-hand coordination. Other key services feature day surgery and endoscopy, advanced diagnostic imaging and laboratory testing, health assessments, visa-required medical examinations, immunization and advisory services, vision correction and optometry, reconstructive and aesthetic surgeries (plastic, head, and neck), dermatological and cosmetic treatments, ongoing chronic disease management, and COVID-19 screening. Furthermore, UMP Healthcare is involved in delivering training and advisory services within the healthcare sector. Its client base includes insurance providers, corporate clients, and individual self-paying patients. The organization maintains a vast network of roughly 1,100 directly owned and partnered service facilities. Established in 1990, UMP Healthcare Holdings Limited has its main offices situated in Central, Hong Kong.
